build_Loss_loc_cls: build a Loss_loc_cls instance with an opt dict containing temporal_scale, focal_alpha, decoder_num_classes, and iou_thr keys
run_Loss_loc_cls_call: run Loss_loc_cls call method with cls_pred_dec, reg_pred_dec, anchors, gt_bbox, and num_gt to compute classification and regression losses
